### Continuing Brotherly Love
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/continuing-brotherly-love
Passage: Hebrews 13:1
Points:
- Sound doctrine serves as the essential foundation for practical Christian living.
- Brotherly love provides the mutual encouragement believers need to persevere in faith.
- True Christian love is defined by concrete sacrifice rather than mere internal feelings.
- The Holy Spirit gives every believer an active desire to love and serve fellow Christians.

### Don't Ignore God's Call to Hospitality
Author: Drew Williams
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/don-t-ignore-god-s-call-to-hospitality-bible-study-minute-february-1-2018.html
Passage: Hebrews 13:2
Points:
- Biblical hospitality means caring for unfamiliar people rather than merely hosting friends.
- Practicing hospitality requires slowing down to notice those God places along our path.
- Sharing hospitality makes believers active channels of divine grace instead of dead ends.
- Welcoming strangers overcomes self-centered fear and mirrors the unconditional welcome God extends to us.
